description: Expand Makefile lint/format scope to match CI coverage (telegram_bot/, tests/, scripts/), add a py_compile syntax check hook, add make pre-push target, add DONE JSON validator script, and update documentation for Codex/OpenCode swarm compatibility.
steps: Step 1: Expand Makefile `lint` and `lint-fix` targets from `src/` to `src/ telegram_bot/ tests/ scripts/` to match CI coverage. Expand `format` and `format-check` targets similarly.

Step 2: Add a local pre-commit hook entry in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` that runs `python -m py_compile` on changed Python files to catch syntax errors early. Use a `local` repo hook with `entry: python -m py_compile`, `types: [python]`, `stages: [pre-commit]`. Place it before the ruff hooks.
Step 3: Fix `default_language_version` in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` from `python3.14` to `python3.12` to match the recommended dev Python version and avoid version-not-found errors.

Step 4: Add a `make pre-push` Makefile target that runs: expanded lint (make lint), type-check (make type-check), format check (make format-check), and optionally focused unit tests for changed paths. This serves as a heavier local gate that developers or workers can run before pushing.

Step 5: Create `scripts/validate_done_json.py` - a DONE JSON schema validator script. It should validate a DONE JSON file (from stdin or file argument) against an expected schema: required fields (status, worker, task, worktree, branch, head_sha, reserved_files, changed_files, superpowers_used, skipped_superpowers, evidence_commands), status must be DONE|FAILED|BLOCKED, changed_files must be a list of strings (not nested objects). Print clear error messages on validation failure. Include a shebang and make it executable.

Step 6: Add a `check-done-json` local hook in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (pre-push stage) that runs the validator on any `*.done.json` files if they exist in the commit. Use `entry: python scripts/validate_done_json.py`, `types: [json]`, `files: \.done\.json$`, `stages: [pre-push]`.

Step 7: Update `docs/LOCAL-DEVELOPMENT.md` Section 4 (Development Gates) to document: the new `make pre-push` target, how hooks interact with uv environments (hooks use their own isolated venvs via pre-commit, not the project venv), how hooks work in OpenCode worker worktrees (pre-commit installs per-worktree, each worktree gets hooks via `make setup-hooks`), and that hooks should not mutate unrelated files in dirty checkouts (fail_fast: true ensures this).
Step 8: Update `CONTRIBUTING.md` to reference `make pre-push` as the recommended pre-push gate and mention the setup-hooks target.

Step 9: Add tests in `tests/unit/test_validate_done_json.py` to verify the DONE JSON validator: test valid DONE JSON passes, test missing required fields fails, test invalid status value fails, test changed_files with non-string entries fails, test commands field rejects nested objects.

Step 10: Add a contract test in `tests/unit/test_ci_deploy_workflow.py` asserting that Makefile lint target covers both `src/` and `telegram_bot/` (verifying parity between local make targets and CI).
acceptance_criteria: `make lint` now checks src/ telegram_bot/ tests/ scripts/ (matching CI coverage)
`make format` now formats src/ telegram_bot/ tests/ scripts/
`.pre-commit-config.yaml` has a py_compile hook that catches syntax errors in all Python files
`make pre-push` runs expanded lint + type-check + format-check
`scripts/validate_done_json.py` exists and validates DONE JSON schema correctly
Contract test verifying Makefile lint scope parity with CI passes
Documentation in docs/LOCAL-DEVELOPMENT.md and CONTRIBUTING.md is updated
`make check` still passes after all changes
`make test-unit` still passes after all changes
